import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        int cap;
        long cost;
        Edge rev;

        Edge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost, Edge rev) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class FlowBase {
        ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
        int n;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        FlowBase(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            adj = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int size() { return n; }

        ArrayList<Edge> get(int node) { return adj[node]; }

        void add_edge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            Edge e = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
            Edge rev = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null);
            e.rev = rev;
            rev.rev = e;
            adj[src].add(e);
            adj[dst].add(rev);
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow extends FlowBase {
        long minCost, totalCost;
        int[] supp;
        long[] ptnl, dist;
        Edge[] last;

        MinCostFlow(int _n) {
            super(_n + 2);
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supp = new int[_n + 2];
            ptnl = new long[_n + 2];
            dist = new long[_n + 2];
            last = new Edge[_n + 2];
        }

        int size() { return n - 2; }

        void supply(int node, int vol) { supp[node] += vol; }

        void add_edge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supp[src] -= cap;
                supp[dst] += cap;
                minCost += cap * cost;
                totalCost -= cap * cost;
                super.add_edge(dst, src, cap, -cost);
            } else {
                totalCost += cap * cost;
                super.add_edge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            }
        }

        boolean solve() {
            int users = size();
            int src = users;
            int sink = users + 1;
            int baseSize = n;
            long flow = 0;
            long suppSum = 0;
            for (int node = 0; node < baseSize; node++) {
                suppSum += supp[node];
                if (supp[node] > 0) {
                    flow += supp[node];
                    add_edge(src, node, supp[node], 0);
                } else if (supp[node] < 0) {
                    add_edge(node, sink, -supp[node], 0);
                }
                supp[node] = 0;
            }
            if (suppSum != 0) return false;

            while (flow > 0) {
                if (!dijkstra(src, sink)) return false;
                long resid = flow;
                for (int node = sink; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                    resid = Math.min(resid, last[node].cap);
                }
                flow -= resid;
                minCost += ptnl[sink] * resid;
                for (int node = sink; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                    last[node].cap -= resid;
                    last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        boolean dijkstra(int src, int sink) {
            long infty = totalCost + 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < dist.length; i++) dist[i] = infty;
            dist[src] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, src});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = pq.poll();
                long ndist = cur[0];
                int now = (int) cur[1];
                if (ndist != dist[now]) continue;
                ptnl[now] += ndist;
                dist[now] = -1;
                for (Edge e : adj[now]) {
                    if (dist[e.dst] == -1 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    if (dist[e.dst] + ptnl[e.dst] > ptnl[now] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.dst] = ptnl[now] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                        last[e.dst] = e;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[sink] == -1;
        }

        long optimal() {
            solve();
            return minCost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    long cost = c + d * (2L * x + 1);
                    mcf.add_edge(u, nv, 1, cost);
                    mcf.add_edge(v, nu, 1, cost);
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.add_edge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.add_edge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
